verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the master-site UI behavior of displaying locations and routing visitors through location sublinks.
The target-explicit response to the client's proposed architecture establishes routing from the master site to each location's separate Wix website.
The client adds concrete homepage selector placement, current selectable locations, and routing to dedicated location pages.
This is the first concrete failure showing that the coming-soon location button was not linked to its destination.
The client explicitly requires a location-selection menu on the Shatter House USA homepage that routes visitors to the appropriate location website.
